name: Scenario Feature Card
css: .scenario-feature-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: #fff; border-radius: 18px; height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); transition: opacity 0.5s, transform 0.5s; }
